semanticReview.method: Seguimiento de fuentes: consulta de diccionarios y materiales académicos/institucionales abiertos; cotejo de localizadores explícitos y alcance. La evidencia parcial no se convirtió en VERIFIED.
findings: La fuente académica trata las funciones de 은/는 como tópico y contraste con datos de aprendientes; sus resultados no prueban que cada oración con 은/는 tenga un único valor.
limitations: Resultados de corpus/experimento no son una regla universal de cada oración; sin Evidence ni assessEntry.

repositories: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean language norms and pronunciation standard
National Institute of Korean Language / Korean-English Learners’ Dictionary
King Sejong Institute / NIKL official teacher materials

partialHits.title: Acquisition of the structures of Korean sentential topic and focus
partialHits.reference: Jeong, H. (2011). Acquisition of the structures of Korean sentential topic and focus: With a focus on eun/neun and i/ga. Korean Language Education, 22(3), 285–304. https://doi.org/10.18209/iakle.2011.22.3.285
partialHits.locator: Abstract and article pp. 285–304: analyzes eun/neun and i/ga as topic/contrast and focus/neutral in learner data; four proficiency groups.
partialHits.supports: The topic/focus distinction and learner variation are not captured by one invariant translation rule.
partialHits.limitation: Does not establish all grammatical subject/object uses, consonant/vowel allomorphs, or validate every example in the entry.
